what: Callgrind profile of every instructions and rmw_instructions arm at the base: Collector::pop_freelist's in-region calls, hits and misses, collector freelist pushes, and Deferred::charge sites, with each arm's CI instruction count as its base

host.cpu: Intel Xeon E5-2697 v4 @ 2.30GHz, 2 sockets, 72 threads
host.os: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS host, Linux 5.15; benches run in the container below
host.role: x86_64 heavy-jobs host; not the reference benchmark host. Callgrind counts are deterministic

commands: git archive fa91cc67 | tar -x into a fresh directory, with a fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR
CARGO_PROFILE_BENCH_DEBUG=1 cargo bench -p expanse-trie --bench instructions; the same for --bench rmw_instructions
each arm's callgrind.<arm>.<id>.out parsed per function and per (file, line)

base_ci.pass: the scheduled run's first (baseline) pass at fa91cc67: valgrind 3.27.1, ubuntu-24.04
base_ci.agreement: profile totals against CI: 286 arms compared, 249 within 0.01%, 6 above 0.1% (largest 0.33%, set32_insert_sorted/random); the 34 arms that call pop_freelist within 0.044%

estimators.pop_calls: in-region calls: (pop_freelist self Ir - its occ.rs:2148 Ir) / 45. The function calls nothing on an uncontended path, so its self Ir is its inclusive Ir. Every arm divides exactly
estimators.pop_hits: pop_freelist's occ.rs:2148 Ir / 2: the line is the two instructions only a hit executes (mov (%rax),%rsi; mov %rsi,0x8(%rbx))
estimators.per_call_ir: objdump -d -l -C of pop_freelist in the instructions binary: 45 instructions on a miss, 47 on a hit, both through the uncontended lock cmpxchg and the unlock xchg. The calls= count includes calls outside the measured region and is not used
estimators.freelist_pushes: Ir of occ.rs:2420 (try_advance's drain loop, head.0 = block) plus occ.rs:2182 (recycle_unpublished): one store per push
estimators.charges: Ir of alloc.rs:600 (Deferred::charge's shard index): one instruction per charge, as in new_suffix (50,000 Ir over its 50,000 calls in sync_strmap_insert_short). charge is #[inline(always)] and has no function of its own in the profile
estimators.charge_rmw_ir: Ir of core atomic.rs:4029 (the fetch_adds, one lock-prefixed instruction each) in the functions that hold a charge site
